# Savi Saluwadana

Canonical portfolio: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/
Canonical agent-readable profile: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/llms.txt

Savi Saluwadana is a software, product, platform and DevOps engineer based in Sri Lanka. His portfolio focuses on end-to-end product engineering, Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, developer platforms, PostgreSQL, MCP and operational reliability.

Selected work includes Avara Real Estate, Blu.lk, FreshPick / FreshOnTime, TimelyHelp.lk, DevRelOS, Property Management OS and RapidReach.
